title: Retro-Futuristic AI Cinematic Video -Ice Skating | VE03 Animation + Suno - Kelly Boesch | 4K
description:
👉 If you like my work, I post new AI art and cinematic videos daily — subscribe to follow the journey.

I made a video with strange skaters about this time last year. Insane how far the animation has come. They can now jump and really skate. Some surreal roller skaters and ice skaters. Foot some reason I find this so soothing to watch. Images made using #Midjourney  I used the old Dalle images from last year as style reference to get a similar but more updated  look. Animated using #VEO3 and song made using @Suno. 

#ai #aiart #aivideo #aiskating #animation #iceskating #surreal #surrealism
